scope: Preparation module, declared registry fixtures and actual WorkshopStore dispatch/replay with isolated in-memory storage; no browser, network or hardware.
checks: The exact requested project is required; unknown or ambiguous identities cannot fall back to the active dossier.
No demo slot, material, name, procedure or volume can become a real candidate without a declared registry.
A real FDM declaration overrides the resin demo slot; changing only declared dimensions changes the geometric conclusion.
All six dimensional orientations are proper rotations, never reflected geometry, with stable source-axis mappings.
Axis-specific limits preserve orientation meaning, and exact equality reports zero raw clearance without claiming support space.
Unknown and mismatched technologies cannot qualify a geometrically fitting envelope.
The useful machine volume must be present in the registry; no demo volume fills an empty declaration.
An asset reference or stored piece dimensions alone do not prove a locally accessible measured STL.
File evidence is tied to the exact dossier, piece revision, asset and unit; stale or duplicate checks are not silently selected.
Actual measured millimetres remain authoritative, including inch imports, without rescaling by stored dimensions or requested project height.
Malformed measurements, evidence metadata or fingerprints cannot yield measured geometry or candidates.
A measured planar STL remains inspectable but has no volumetric candidate; raw box fitting does not claim mesh closure.
Material names, complete slicer references and a documented test remain declarations, never automatic readiness.
Project quantity produces no invented nesting, duration, assignments or geometry scaling.
Exports freeze the inspected dossier, registry revisions and SHA256 even after the workshop selection or source records change.
Exports reject foreign selection identities and uncomputed orientations while allowing incomplete reports without an invented selection.
A delayed targeted import cannot replace a file changed by another screen while the STL was being read.
A guarded association succeeds only on its original piece and leaves other dossiers and selection unchanged.
Replay guards require the exact previous asset as well as revision, reject a missing target, and preserve legacy operations.
Import guards are paired, typed and context bound before persistence; undefined or invalid inputs cannot disappear through JSON cloning.
